name: update_trigger
description: Update a Routine's name, cron expression, enabled state, or model. Only provided fields are changed; omit a field to leave it as-is. The Routine must belong to this account. Use list_triggers to find the trigger_id if it's no longer in context.

trigger_id.description: The Routine's trigger ID to update (starts with 'trig_').

cron_expression.description: New 5-field cron expression. Minimum interval is hourly. Setting this clears run_once_at.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the Routine. Disabled Routines stay stored but never fire.

run_once_at.description: New RFC3339 one-shot fire time. Must be in the future. Setting this clears cron_expression.

model.description: Change the model used for this Routine's future fires. Use ONLY when a human explicitly asks to change the Routine's model.
